messages.subject: calculating detection probability
parts:
Hello,
I've run several pcount models for different study areas.  In some cases the best models were constants only (i.e., lam[.]p[.]) and in some cases covariate models performed best.  I'd like to calculate the detection probability given presence for each of the models, but I don't think I'm doing it correctly.  I'm using the predict function for each model to determine detection probability but the probability is really small <0.008 for the constants only models, and it is only around 0.04 or so for the covariate models.  This seems far too low as c. 75% of sites detected an animal.  Any help in this regard would be really helpful.  Thanks.
--Neil
